site.title: La Jetée Films | Documenting the Margins of Reality
site.description: La Jetée Films: We create feature films, short films and exhibitions that give voice to forgotten stories. Each work, an act of resistance against oblivion.

preproduction.description: Cerdos, the war is not over.

memorias.title: Memories of Hope
memorias.description: Natural Sciences Museum of La Plata City, Argentina. Through glass plates from 1905, we travel to its origin. The original cities of Jujuy tell their search for memory.

avefria.title: The Return of the Lapwing
avefria.description: Theater humanizes. Journey of a bird: a lapwing, reaching a city and finding its streets full of artistic activity. A stone city, the tenderness of theater.

godot.title: Waiting for Godot
godot.description: Film about Fernando Urdiales, a great Castilian and Leonese playwright who died in Valladolid in 2010.

agapito.title: Trailer Agapito Marazuela, The Broken Statue
agapito.description: Portrait of a universal musician: Agapito Marazuela. Great man who had a life that shows the historical circumstances of the 20th century in Spain: joy for culture, dictatorships, repression, misery, fear, oblivion.
